Messages.Author: hartman@ulogic.com
Messages.Body:
A recent commercial message here mentioned that Jyhad would be
available in starter decks.  From this I gather that Jyhad is
WotC's second deckmaster game, not just an expansion to MtG (sorry
if this is in the newsletter, I haven't subscribed).  My question is
(if my assumption is correct) will Jyhad be interoperable w/ MtG?
That is, can I just buy a few boosters to add to my Magic cards, or
is a completely separate game that must be played separately?

-rmh

Jyhad is a completely separate game from Magic the Gathering.  The cards 
will not be compatible between the different games.

Messages.Body:

>A recent commercial message here mentioned that Jyhad would be

>WotC's second deckmaster game, not just an expansion to MtG (sorry
>if this is in the newsletter, I haven't subscribed).  My question is
>(if my assumption is correct) will Jyhad be interoperable w/ MtG?

Jyhad is a completely separate game from Magic, and the two are not
designed to be interchangeable.  You could *try* to mix the two, but
you'd really have to work at it hard.
